purpose: Determine whether the previously observed adverse high relative-rank-acceleration leg implies a genuine low-acceleration long alpha, a continuous overacceleration penalty, or high-leg avoidance only.

research_window.validation_access: Only after every generation gate passes for at least one family; this is a fixed diagnostic split within already consumed history, not OOS.

population.definition: Exact Cycle-009 eligible all-A frame with 120 consecutive causal observations, valid PIT lineage, current tradability, non-ST state, and prior-20-session mean amount at least CNY 50 million.

families.mechanism: Extreme improvement in the same-date rank of trailing-20 market-residual return may represent crowded late demand; low or negative rank change may instead capture uncrowded relative reset.
families.exact_score: Same-date percentile rank of trailing-20 causal return minus cross-sectional median causal return, minus the same percentile rank exactly 20 sessions earlier.
families.known_prior_result: Cycle-009 selected the highest 20 scores and found -1.260% h20 net excess; the low leg and full bucket ordering were not evaluated.

families.mechanism: Rapid within-industry rank catch-up by prior followers may be late diffusion rather than durable leadership; low acceleration may identify an unforced reset.
families.exact_score: Within-PIT-industry percentile rank of trailing-20 residual return minus its value exactly 20 sessions earlier, restricted to prior below-industry-median rank.
families.known_prior_result: Cycle-009 selected the highest 20 scores and found -0.835% h20 net excess; the low leg and full bucket ordering were not evaluated.

anatomy.buckets: Within each decision date, deterministic equal-count quintiles of the exact score; Q1 is lowest acceleration and Q5 highest acceleration.
anatomy.response: Next legal open through twentieth completed-session close, accepted QD-010 corporate-action handling, 20 bps per side.
required_metrics: four adjacent favorable steps from Q1 to Q5

executable_translation.authorization: Only families passing every generation and fixed-validation gate.
executable_translation.selection_if_both_pass: Choose the family with the larger minimum of generation and validation Q1 excess versus all eligible; deterministic family-id tie break.
executable_translation.rule: At each exact 20-session decision close, rank the exact acceleration score ascending, retain the lowest 20, and equal-weight the lowest 10 at the next legal open.

success_target.interpretation: User optimization target only; never tune the frozen definition to cross it.

prohibited: OOS, independent-validation, confirmation, or live language
changing either Cycle-009 score, schedule, universe, cost, horizon, or direction after outcomes
alternative bucket counts, Top-N values, residual definitions, industry definitions, or liquidity floors
champion combination or veto unless a separate later experiment is frozen after this anatomy
using the high leg as a short strategy
